finding.issue: Route execution semantics ambiguity: continuous driving vs pose replay
finding.observed: The published strict route helper uses set_transform() at each requested pose, which is POSE_REPLAY semantics (controlled viewpoint sampling), not CONTINUOUS_DRIVING (actual vehicle traversal with physics).
finding.decision: NOT unilaterally redesigned. The frozen RQ3 protocol text is authoritative and is frozen; this assignment must not alter it.
finding.action: ESCALATED to the scientific owner (Codex/RQ5 protocol owner) for adjudication.
finding.interim_rule: Any capture produced via the pose-replay helper MUST be labelled method=POSE_REPLAY and MUST NOT be reported as physically continuous driving.

status_detail: Software contract is specified; scientific adjudication outstanding.
